reference.title: Detailed Results From the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) March 2009 to December 2011
reference.authors: Dietrich, Ferkul, Bryg, Nayagam, Hicks, Williams, Dryer, Shaw, Choi, Avedisian

relevant_sections.abstract: presents the results of the first 284 tests performed
relevant_sections.appendix_A.1_p19: column definitions incl. Burning rate (average burning rate constant from a linear fit of D^2 vs t from shortly after ignition to extinction) and CO2 (ambient carbon dioxide mole fraction)
relevant_sections.table_IX_p20_onward: headers incl. 'Burning rate, mm2/s' and initial ambient composition O2 N2 CO2 He
relevant_sections.appendix_B_p29: Figures 5 to 280 show D^2(t) and flame diameter per test; per-test text files on a DVD addendum (not acquired)

method: Text extracted from the PDF with pypdf 7.0.1 (scratch install, not a project dependency). Table IX rows parsed by regex and matched to PSI-69 rows on identifier, fuel, test end and 9 numeric fields (pressure, O2, N2, CO2, He, D0, extinction diameter, burning rate, burn time) by exact equality.

results.psi_test_number_is_not_report_flex_numbe: PSI 'FLEX Test #' is sequential; it differs from the report FLEX number for 119 of 274 rows (from PSI #156 = FLEX-157). Corrected 2026-11-13 audit: an earlier figure of 120 came from a join that collided on the duplicate identifier 193F001.
results.duplicate_identifier: 193F001 appears twice with identical date/GMT and different values in BOTH the report (FLEX-070/073) and PSI (#70/#73).
results.visual_verification: PDF pages rendered with PDFium (pypdfium2, scratch install) on 2026-11-13: FLEX-156/205/213/228 are numbering skips (no row printed, no Appendix B figure), NOT blank or unreadable rows. FLEX-216 and FLEX-230 are printed in full. FLEX-130 (K .05) and FLEX-070/073 (shared identifier 193F001, GMT 7:25:43) confirmed as printed.
results.flex_156_note: Matrix Table VIII lists a FLEX-156 (heptane, Dec. 9, 2010) but Table IX and Appendix B contain no result for it.

unresolved: Report abstract states 'the first 284 tests'; Table IX prints 276 rows numbered FLEX-001..280 (156, 205, 213, 228 not printed). The 284-vs-280-vs-276 difference is not explained in the report.
Why PSI omits FLEX-216 and FLEX-230 (both printed in Table IX) is unknown; ask PSI curators.
Appendix A intro says 'March 2009 through December 2010' while the title, sec. 4.1 and the dated rows run to December 2011.

FLEX-070 and FLEX-073 share identifier and GMT in Table IX with different values; Table V matrix D0 (1.30 vs 4.72 mm) and the captions describe different tests. Which Table IX row belongs to which test cannot be established.
FLEX-114 pressure: Table IX/PSI 0 mmHg vs Table VI 0.70 atm and caption '0.70-atm'.
verified_scope: PSI-69 table = 274 of the 276 rows printed in Table IX (visually verified), value-identical; it covers FLEX-001..FLEX-280 except FLEX-216 and FLEX-230. FLEX-156/205/213/228 are not printed in Table IX.
